facts.raw_span: A 50-year-old man presented with subjective fevers
shortness of breath, and worsening cough for 6 days
Common variable immunodeficiency (CVID) receiving intravenous immunoglobulin every 3 weeks
HIV with undetectable viral load, CD4 count 140 cells/µL on therapy
Chronic bronchiectasis with history of Mycobacterium avium complex pulmonary infection
Oxygen saturation was 97% on room air
Developed bilateral lower-extremity edema
Ulceration of the glans penis noted during treatment course
CD4 count: 140 cells/µL
HIV viral load: Undetectable
CT scan of the chest  Image Description: Shows bronchiectasis with no consolidations or ground-glass opacities
Viral resistance testing showed mutations in UL97 (C592G) and UL54 (N408K) genes
